public_definitions: Review the regional air-quality dashboard and select the follow-up route that best matches the overall dashboard trend for the 2018-2023 planning case.
Use the dashboard trend as the basis for assigning this case to the most appropriate follow-up pathway.

The three available options are: 'Route the record to routine air-quality recovery monitoring', 'Route the record to air-quality recovery expansion follow-up', and 'Route the record to air-quality deterioration response review'.
